title: Sparse Integer Fourier Transform and Its Application In Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.21976v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Discrete Fourier transform, mainly implemented by Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), has been essential for numerous domains, such as digital signal processing and feature extraction in materials design. However, current FFT methods suffer from extensive non-trivial multiplications and twiddle-factor operations in the big data era. To improve the computational efficiency of FFT, this study proposes Sparse Integer Fourier Transform (SIFT), a method that leverages the fast computing of sparsity and small integers, and applies the Radix-n method to derive an FFT. The 2N-point DFT matrix in Radix-n FFT is decomposed into four sparse integer matrices. A diagonal matrix containing complex twiddle factors is efficiently approximated using an optimization strategy while the remaining matrices retain sparsity and integer entries. translated_title: 稀疏整数傅里叶变换及其在机器学习中的应用
translated_abstract: 离散傅里叶变换（主要通过快速傅里叶变换FFT实现）在众多领域中都至关重要，例如数字信号处理和材料设计中的特征提取。然而，在大数据时代，当前的FFT方法存在大量非平凡乘法和旋转因子操作的问题。为了提高FFT的计算效率，本研究提出了稀疏整数傅里叶变换，该方法利用稀疏性和小整数的快速计算优势，并应用基数n方法来推导FFT。基数n FFT中的2N点DFT矩阵被分解为四个稀疏整数矩阵。包含复数旋转因子的对角矩阵通过优化策略进行高效近似，而其余矩阵则保持稀疏性和整数条目。对于基数32的FFT，SIFT将估计的算术成本降低了75%，均方根误差（RMSE）低于2.3765×10⁻⁸，MAPE b
tldr: 本研究提出稀疏整数傅里叶变换（SIFT），通过将DFT矩阵分解为稀疏整数矩阵并用优化策略近似旋转因子，将基数32 FFT的算术成本降低75%，同时保持极低的误差水平。
en_tdlr: This study proposes Sparse Integer Fourier Transform (SIFT), which decomposes the DFT matrix into sparse integer matrices and approximates twiddle factors via an optimization strategy, reducing the arithmetic cost of radix-32 FFT by 75% while maintaining extremely low error.
